shots.line: Under the northern lights, you found three AI and Data startups across Helsinki.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2 stands Verda, founded in 2020 by Ruben Bryon to build data centres and GPU cloud platforms.
Nearby at Antinkatu 1 is Flow AI, another AI and Data company founded in 2020.
At Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot builds an AI governance platform that maps models, datasets, and compliance requirements.
Three companies, mapped across the night sky of Helsinki.
